title: Webhook freshness and replay resistance
owaspMappings: OWASP API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs
summary: A webhook endpoint validates an HMAC but does not enforce freshness or one-time processing.
securityInvariant: A webhook is accepted only when its signature is valid, its signed timestamp is within the configured window, and its event identifier has not already been processed.
visibleBehavior: A valid current webhook is accepted.
securityOracle: A stale signed delivery is rejected.
A missing event identifier is rejected.

variants.vulnerable: Validates the signature but ignores timestamp age and replay state.
variants.naive: Adds freshness validation but still permits duplicate processing.
variants.reference: Uses constant-time signature comparison, a freshness window, and replay state.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
